editor_note: All five rewritten entries (9, 44, 67, 68, 69) say what the English says. The binary/bounded-integer requirement, error codes 4710 and 4712, the postprocessing_level mapping with the default still at 3, and the variable_mapping explanation are all accurate. Nothing here would mislead a learner. Two small grammar slips remain. In entry 67, "habang preprocessing" is missing a word and should read "habang nasa preprocessing". In entry 69, "at na kailangan" copies the English "and that" and reads more naturally as "at kailangan".

examples.source: The field is `None` when the problem was solved during preprocessing and no circuit was run
examples.translation: Ang field ay `None` kapag nalutas ang problema habang preprocessing at walang circuit na pinatakbo
examples.suggested: Ang field ay `None` kapag nalutas na ang problema habang nasa preprocessing at walang circuit na pinatakbo
examples.why: "habang" needs a verb or "nasa" before a noun. As written, the phrase is ungrammatical, though the meaning is still clear.

examples.source: Documented that continuous (real-valued) variables are not supported and that integer variables require explicit bounds.
examples.translation: Idinokumento na hindi sinusuportahan ang mga continuous (real-valued) na variable at na kailangan ng tahasang bound ng mga integer variable.
examples.suggested: Idinokumento na hindi sinusuportahan ang mga continuous (real-valued) na variable at kailangan ng tahasang bound ang mga integer variable.
examples.why: "at na" copies the English "and that" word for word, which reads stiff in Tagalog. Making "integer variable" the subject is also more natural.

editor_note: Entry 28 is faithful: "ang QPU time ay minimal at halos constant, dahil isang round lang ng QAOA ang ginagamit na may optimal na circuit parameters na nakuha sa CPU" keeps the cause and the qualifier "almost" from the English, and the QOBLIB instance-name sentence also matches.

Entries 40 and 44 are faithful. The numbers are all right: N = 50 with 51 qubit sa kabuuan, and width 9 with 10 total qubits. The register is natural, e.g. "Para makatipid sa oras ng QPU", "hindi-bale-walang success probability". Entry 41 drops the hedge "near": "while Orbit remains near 80–90%" became "nananatili ang Orbit sa 80–90%", which states an approximate range as exact. It is a small dropped qualifier and does not mislead a learner.

examples.line_approx: On ibm_miami ... while Orbit remains near 80–90%
examples.suggested: habang nananatili ang Orbit malapit sa 80–90%
examples.why: The approximating qualifier "near" was dropped, so a hedged benchmark figure now reads as an exact range.

editor_note: Entries 72 and 73 keep the English meaning. Q is still the CNOT control, A is still the target, H is still applied to Q afterward, and the math is unchanged. Two native-editor slips remain. In the entry-72 heading, "Ni-entangle ng Alice" uses the common-noun marker "ng" before a personal name where "ni Alice" is needed, and "kumikilos si Alice gamit ang isang CNOT gate" copies the English "operates with" word for word. In entry 73, "ipaggrupo natin" is a non-standard verb form, and "igrupo natin" or "pagpangkatin natin" would read more naturally.

examples.source: __Alice entangles qubits A and Q:__ Alice now operates with a CNOT gate with Q as the control and her own qubit as the target
examples.translation: __Ni-entangle ng Alice ang mga qubit A at Q:__ Ngayon ay kumikilos si Alice gamit ang isang CNOT gate na ang Q ang control
examples.suggested: __Ni-entangle ni Alice ang mga qubit A at Q:__ Ngayon ay naglalapat si Alice ng CNOT gate na ang Q ang control at ang sarili niyang qubit ang target
examples.why: A personal name needs the marker 'ni', not 'ng'. Also, 'kumikilos ... gamit ang' copies the English 'operates with' and reads stiffly.

examples.line_approx: prose line between the two equation blocks
examples.source: let us group the terms above according to the outcomes of measurements on qubits A and Q
examples.translation: ipaggrupo natin ang mga termino sa itaas ayon sa mga resulta ng mga sukat sa mga qubit A at Q
examples.suggested: igrupo natin ang mga termino sa itaas ayon sa mga resulta ng pagsukat sa mga qubit A at Q
examples.why: 'ipaggrupo' is a non-standard affixed form, and 'igrupo' or 'pagpangkatin' is the natural verb. The meaning is preserved.

editor_note: Entries 78 and 87 are faithful and read naturally. In 78, "ibig sabihin ay maraming degenerate optima ang natagpuan" and "posisyon ng karakter ng bawat variable" keep the full meaning, and 87 keeps all three recommendations and the option list. Entry 53 has two small problems. "i-fix ang opsyong `seed_transpiler`" can be read as "repair the option", because in everyday Taglish "i-fix" usually means "ayusin". The English means "set it to a fixed value". Also, "sa bawat takbo" ("in each run") is weaker than "across runs", which means the result stays the same from one run to the next. A careful reader can still work out the meaning from context, so this does not mislead enough to be a FAIL.

examples.source: If you want the circuit mapping to be reproducible across runs, fix the `seed_transpiler` option.
examples.translation: Kung gusto mong maging reproducible ang circuit mapping sa bawat takbo, i-fix ang opsyong `seed_transpiler`.
examples.suggested: Kung gusto mong pare-pareho (reproducible) ang circuit mapping sa iba't ibang takbo, magtakda ng nakapirming halaga para sa opsyong `seed_transpiler`.
examples.why: In Taglish, 'i-fix' usually means 'repair', but here it means 'set to a fixed value'. 'Sa bawat takbo' (in each run) also loses the 'stays the same between runs' sense of 'across runs'.

editor_note: Entry 60 is faithful and natural: "I-benchmark ang QFT process fidelity gamit ang Orbit, isang Qiskit Function ng Quantum Elements" keeps the imperative (matching sibling titles such as "I-refresh ang mga backend property…"), leaves "Qiskit Function" in English as house style requires, and renders "by" correctly as "ng".

Rewritten entry 12 keeps the meaning: random positive and negative J_ij, the triangular example, and frustration that is "lalong lumalala sa buong sistema" and leads to a "network ng nagkakasalungat na mga hadlang". One wording slip: "minimize all interactions" became "mabawasan ang lahat ng interaksyon", which reads as "lessen/reduce the interactions" rather than minimizing each bond's energy. It is also inconsistent with the file's own "nagpapaliit" for "minimizes" in entries 19 and 44. This does not mislead in context, so it is minor.

examples.line_approx: hindi maaaring ayusin ang mga spin upang mabawasan ang lahat ng interaksyon nang sabay-sabay
examples.source: where spins cannot be arranged to minimize all interactions simultaneously
examples.translation: kung saan hindi maaaring ayusin ang mga spin upang mabawasan ang lahat ng interaksyon nang sabay-sabay
examples.suggested: kung saan hindi maaaring ayusin ang mga spin para mapaliit ang enerhiya ng lahat ng interaksyon nang sabay-sabay
examples.why: 'mabawasan' means 'reduce/lessen' and suggests the interactions themselves shrink. The idea is minimizing each interaction's energy. Using 'mapaliit' also matches 'nagpapaliit' in entries 19 and 44.

editor_note: None of the 23 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The claims and numbers match the English, including the O(n^2) vs O(n) argument and its "Basta't sapat na mababa ang error" condition in [17], the 60/300 PUB counts in [49], and the remedies NUM_BATCH_PARTITIONS/M/N_VALUES in [32] and [67]. Three phrasing slips are left. In [35], "Idinaragdag pagkatapos ng notebook" can be misread as "after the notebook". In [46], the hybrid "inaalternate ang kanilang order" sits next to "pagkakasunod-sunod" in the same entry. In [51], "Nabubuo rin" for "recovers" suggests the counts are constructed rather than retrieved.

examples.source: The notebook then appends either the standard unitary QFT or its semiclassical dynamic QFT equivalent.
examples.translation: Idinaragdag pagkatapos ng notebook ang alinman sa standard unitary QFT o ang semiclassical dynamic QFT na katumbas nito.
examples.suggested: Pagkatapos, idinaragdag ng notebook ang alinman sa standard unitary QFT o ang katumbas nitong semiclassical dynamic QFT.
examples.why: Because 'pagkatapos' comes right before 'ng notebook', a reader can parse it as 'after the notebook' instead of 'the notebook then'. Moving 'Pagkatapos' to the front of the sentence removes that reading.

examples.source: pairs large and small circuit sizes, alternates their order
examples.translation: Ipinapares ng grouping helper ang malalaki at maliliit na circuit size, inaalternate ang kanilang order
examples.why: 'inaalternate ang kanilang order' is an awkward English-Tagalog hybrid. The same entry already uses 'pagkakasunod-sunod' for 'order'.

examples.source: `extract_raw_counts` also recovers the corresponding unmitigated counts recorded in Orbit metadata.
examples.translation: Nabubuo rin ng `extract_raw_counts` ang katumbas na unmitigated na count na naitala sa Orbit metadata.
examples.suggested: Nakukuha rin ng `extract_raw_counts` ang katumbas na unmitigated na count na naitala sa Orbit metadata.
examples.why: 'Nabubuo' means formed or constructed. The function retrieves counts that are already recorded, so 'Nakukuha' fits the English better.
